summary: Tested the new SAP MSL Write-Back feature end-to-end (backend + frontend, live SAP tenant). All 13 new backend tests pass, 16/16 existing regression tests pass. Frontend Playwright testing confirmed: Lead Time input column persists via PATCH and survives reload, Push to SAP button correctly enabled/disabled based on has_sap_link + msl/lead_time_days presence, 'No SAP link yet' text shown correctly for unlinked components, full Push to SAP dialog flow (GET sap-planning comparison -> Confirm Push -> POST push-to-sap -> success toast with planning-area count -> dialog closes -> timestamp badge updates) verified live against SPC5WM (pushed MSL=500/LeadTime=7 across 7 Supply Planning Areas). Category deletion (X button) also verified working (add TEST_ category then delete it, badge disappears + toast confirms). Light regression on Category Master and Admin/Overrides suites: 16/16 passed.

minor.issue: When run concurrently under pytest-xdist parallel workers (2 workers hitting the live SAP tenant at the same time as the push-to-sap write, which briefly locks the parent Material), both requests intermittently returned 502. Re-running each test class in isolation (sequential) passed 100%. This matches the documented live-SAP-tenant lock behavior in the review request, not a code bug - flagging only as an observation for future testing agents to avoid running push-to-sap tests in parallel with other component-list calls.

critical_code_review_comments: sap_planning_client.py duration helpers (_duration_to_days/_days_to_duration) are correct and covered by unit tests (P4D->4.0, ''->None, 7->'P7D').
push_planning_data() correctly retries on 'Locking object not possible' with backoff, applies to all rows/planning areas atomically per-row - verified live (7/7 rows updated for SPC5WM).
AdminPage.js Push to SAP button disabled logic (msl == null && lead_time_days == null) matches spec exactly; verified both true (disabled) and false (enabled after setting lead_time) states.

Minor design nuance (not a bug): the 'No SAP link yet' span lacks a data-testid, relies on text content match only - fine for now since it's not an interactive element, but could be a hidden risk if the UI copy ever changes and other tests key off this text.
